decisions.quote: We will only ever support the client-side implementation of VerdantUI. There will never be a server outside of the VerdantUI client runtime.
Verdant studio will never make use of WebGPU or any processor API outside of verdant-engine.
We need each push to main to publish to github pages. We need to make sure that the repo stays optimized, so that the development pipeline is not slowed down by validation overhead.
We'll work towards the strict model of Verdant Studio using a version of the Verdant ratchet.

We are dedicated to the highest possible performance; lowest latency, highest throughput implementation. The multi-threaded implementation is required. We are committed to robust and scalable solutions.

Verdant Studio will also be an agent harness in VerdantUI, so that Verdant Apps can be created, published, and managed in VerdantUI. We'll work on the Verdant Studio harness after we refine the VerdantUI implementation.

VerdantUI must be a best-in-class AI service that will provide a Free Public Benefit Service. The implementation of Verdant UI must be maintained to the highest standards including performance standards.

We must implement VerdantUI using Verdant Studio, so that we can maintain a healthy product lifecycle including the lifecycle of VerdantUI features, so that we can automate releases and upgrades and other aspects of software publishing.
The entire Verdant Prism must be procedurally synthesized from the Verdant Studio, so that VerdantUI is only used to route weights onto the Verdant Prism.

We need to establish the user model within the VerdantUI unified model, so that the User can possess its parts of VerdantUI... The Observer also possesses the User in the same way... VerdantUI will route to external sources and must not leak any weights between contexts when it is sending information.
We do not expose verdant constructs such as the Observer or other technical jargon to the user of VerdantUI.

Take all jargon and bloat out of VerdantUI. Do not introduce a bunch of tunables to the user. Users are not going to be uploading their own weights or models. Coherent multi-modal models enabled by verdant-engine improve the performance of VerdantUI.

Instead of exposing more clutter in the UI/UX such as the mediatype selection buttons, the model will select these for the user based on the user's natural language input. When a model attempts a tool-call, the tool called will be a prism. If no prism exists to meet the model's requirement, the model can create a prism, so that it can use its Prism to perform the task of its tool-call.

Artifacts are saved to galleries by mediatype and then further categorized from there... Spaces have content and a view of their content. Each Space is a Verdant Prism. All parts of VerdantUI including its language, vision, image, audio, user, and all other models and content are experts and their weights in the VerdantUI unified model. The VerdantUI training basis is never static, so it grows its knowledge and skills as needed.

Every part of VerdantUI is a natural language interface with a rendering (preview) panel, and a toggle to switch from the preview to the details of the Prism. VerdantUI itself must be a Verdant Prism and all of its parts must also be Verdant Prisms. VerdantUI and all of its parts must be rendered by the Observer using procedural synthesis.

We dont need more UI options. VerdantUI is a natural language interface that renders content to its user. The Observer must make use of Verdant Studio to generate its output. We have these language, audio, image, and video models in VerdantUI, so that their weights can be routed into a Verdant Prism in its procedural synthesis.
Continue to refine the plan with a focus on performance and stability, so that all work is focused on optimizing VerdantUI performance, stability, and functionality.

VerdantUI needs to be a Verdant Prism itself — one Verdant Prism runtime instance rendered by the Observer and maintained by Verdant Studio so navigating between parts never interrupts inference, with cross-modal associative weights and progressive full-fidelity reconciliation.

Post-v0.11.0 refinement and cleanup: eliminate 120ms root re-render storms and redundant Tropical layout solves, add 64-token KV page-boundary checkpointing and MessageChannel yields, promote SDXS-512 neural renders to 100% primary display with lean IndexedDB revisions and live VLM Vision QA, and execute the exact verified 610-tensor SDXS-512 UNet and 19-layer residual TAESD on native F16/Q8_0 WASM SIMD with zero-bloat OPFS/GGUF CLIP BPE.

VerdantUI is not bound by any intelligence or cognitive ceiling: replace arbitrary upfront 4B downloads and Local AI buttons with a first-visit browser-streaming acknowledgment, a hidden unmanaged demand-first System Stream with regimented 3-tier CAS deduplication, continuous Observer intent and quality-budget sensing from immediate and global user context, uncluttered catalog-organized opt-in Content Streams with user-added streams and zero-cutoff Prism ingestion, and an Offline-Only Mode toggle in Settings.

Rebase VerdantUI directly on main onto afflom/verdant-studio's Prism-first discipline so VerdantUI and all its parts are Lean-verified Verdant Prisms (verdant-ui.holo) with zero silent fallbacks, high W3C OTEL observability, zero added dependencies, mechanical surface/WCAG/facet gates, and automated browser evaluation.
